components.note: 辶 (movement, road) — 辶 marks going and moving, as in 过, 进, 送; 述 is following a story along, to narrate.
术 (shù) — same sound — 述 is shù, like 术 (art, technique).
阝 (mound, hill) — left-side 阝 is 阜 (mound), as in 阳, 院, 队; hiding behind a mound — 隐 is to conceal; the right side is a simplified stand-in.
艹 (grass, plants) — 艹 is grass and plants, as in 花, 草, 菜; hiding under vegetation — 藏 is to conceal or store.
臧 (zāng) — near sound — 藏 is cáng; 臧 also sounds out 脏 zāng.
身 (body, bow) — 身 is a worn-down picture of a bow, with a hand 寸 drawing it — 射 is to shoot.
门 (gate, door) — 门 is a gate, as in 开, 关, 问; 阁 is a pavilion with doors.
各 (gè) — same sound — 阁 is gé; 各 also sounds out 格 gé and 胳 gē.
犭 (animal) — 犭 is the animal radical, as in 猫, 狗, 狼; 犹 first named an animal.
尤 (yóu) — same sound — 犹 is yóu, like 尤; 尤 also sounds out 优 yōu.
车 (cart) — 车 is a cart or vehicle, as in 轮, 输, 车; 转 is turning of wheels.
专 (zhuān) — near sound — 转 is zhuǎn; 专 also sounds out 传 chuán and 砖 zhuān.
扌 (hand) — hand radical — 摆 is to arrange or swing with the hands.
罢 (bà) — near sound — 摆 is bǎi, matching 罢.
月 (flesh) — ⺼ is the body radical (月 in 脸, 脑); 脱 is slipping off a layer, like skin or clothes.
兑 (duì) — near sound — 脱 is tuō; 兑 also sounds out 说 shuō and 税 shuì.
鬼 (ghost) — 鬼 is a ghost or spirit, as in 魂, 魔; 魅 is a spirit that bewitches.
未 (wèi) — near sound — 魅 is mèi; 未 also sounds out 妹 mèi.
户 (door) — 户 is a door with 口 below — 启 is opening; the traditional 啓 added a hand.
辶 (movement, road) — 辶 marks going and moving, as in 过, 进, 送; 迷 is losing one's way.
米 (mǐ) — near sound — 迷 is mí, the same syllable with a different tone.
州 (region) — a river 川 with small islands of land in it; 州 is a region, and also sounds out 洲 zhōu.
⺮ (bamboo) — ⺮ is bamboo, as in 笔, 筷, 箱; 筑 was an old instrument, and 建筑 is building, from the older form 築.
手 (hand) — the bottom 手 is a hand — 举 is lifting with the hands, as in 举行.
扌 (hand) — hand radical — 损 is to damage, as in 损失.
员 (yuán) — loose hint — 损 is sǔn.
豕 (pig) — 豕 is a pig, as in 象; 豪 was a bristly boar, then a hero; 高 gives the near sound (also in 毫 háo).
月 (flesh) — ⺼ is the body radical (月 in 脸, 脑); 肚 is the belly.
土 (tǔ) — near sound — 肚 is dù; 土 also sounds out 吐 tǔ.
饣 (food) — 饣 is the simplified 食 (food), as in 饭, 饺, 饿; 饼 is a flat baked cake.
并 (bìng) — near sound — 饼 is bǐng; 并 also sounds out 拼 pīn.
灬 (fire) — 灬 is fire at the bottom, as in 点, 照, 熟; 热 is heat.
亻 (person) — person radical — 仪 is the conduct of a person, as in 仪式 ceremony.
义 (yì) — near sound — 仪 is yí; 义 also sounds out 议 yì.
纟 (silk, thread) — 纟 is the simplified 糸 (thread), as in 红, 给; 络 is a net of threads, as in 网络.
各 (gè) — near sound — 络 is luò; 各 also sounds out 洛 luò and 路 lù.
疒 (illness) — 疒 is the sickness radical, as in 病, 痛, 症; 癌 is cancer.
嵒 (yán) — near sound — 癌 is ái.
疒 (illness) — 疒 is the sickness radical, as in 病, 痛, 痕; 症 is an illness or its symptoms.
正 (zhèng) — same sound — 症 is zhèng, like 正; 正 also sounds out 证 zhèng.
爵 (wine cup) — 爵 was an ancient three-legged bronze wine cup, a mark of rank — so a noble title, as in 公爵.
骨 (bone) — 骨 is the bone radical, as in 骼, 髓, 体; 骨 is bones, with ⺼ (flesh) beneath.
辶 (movement, road) — 辶 marks going and moving, as in 过, 进, 迷; 送 is walking someone off, or delivering.
立 (stand) — traditional 競 shows two people standing side by side in competition; 竞 keeps 立 and one 兄.
礻 (spirit, omen) — 礻 is the ritual radical (示), as in 神, 礼, 福; misfortune was seen as a spirit's doing.
呙 (guō) — loose hint — 祸 is huò; 呙 also sounds out 过 guò and 锅 guō.
日 (sun) — 日 is the sun and time of day, as in 明, 晚, 早; 晨 is early morning.
辰 (chén) — same sound — 晨 is chén, like 辰.
木 (wood) — 木 is wood, as in 桌, 板; a ladder was a wooden structure.
弟 (dì) — near sound — 梯 is tī; 弟 also sounds out 第 dì and 递 dì.
欠 (open mouth) — 欠 shows an open mouth, as in 吹, 歌, 欢; 欺 is deceiving by speech.
其 (qí) — near sound — 欺 is qī; 其 also sounds out 期 qī and 旗 qí.
穴 (hole, cave) — 穴 is a hole, as in 空, 窗, 突; 穿 is to pierce through, and the 牙 is a tooth boring in.
氵 (water) — 氵 is water, as in 河, 海; 洲 is land surrounded by water.
州 (zhōu) — same sound — 洲 is zhōu, like 州; continents like 亚洲 are 洲.
贝 (shell, money) — 贝 is money and value, as in 财, 买; 质 is the real value or substance of something.
扌 (hand) — hand radical — 扮 is to dress or act.
分 (fēn) — loose hint — 扮 is bàn; 分 also sounds out 盼 pàn.
女 (woman) — 女 marks women, as in 妈, 姐; 姿 first meant a woman's bearing.
次 (cì) — near sound — 姿 is zī; 次 also sounds out 资 zī and 咨 zī.
力 (strength) — 力 is strength, as in 办, 动, 努; 势 is force or momentum.
宀 (roof) — 宀 is a roof, as in 家, 室, 安; 宇 is the eaves, then all that is under heaven.
于 (yú) — near sound — 宇 is yǔ; 于 also sounds out 芋 yù.
宀 (roof) — 宀 is a roof, as in 家, 室, 安; 宙 together with 宇 forms 宇宙, space and time.
由 (yóu) — near sound — 宙 is zhòu; 由 also sounds out 抽 chōu and 袖 xiù.
臣 (eye) — 臣 is a picture of an eye looking down; with a person leaning, 卧 is lying down.
刂 (knife) — 刂 is 刀 (knife), as in 到, 别, 利; 剧 first meant to cut deeply, then intense and drama.
居 (jū) — near sound — 剧 is jù; 居 also sounds out 据 jù.
辶 (movement, road) — 辶 marks going and moving, as in 过, 进; 迈 is a big stride.
万 (wàn) — near sound — 迈 is mài, from the traditional 邁 where 萬 gave the sound.
阝 (mound, hill) — left-side 阝 is 阜 (mound), as in 阳, 院; 阿 first meant a slope.
可 (kě) — near sound — 阿 is ā; 可 also sounds out 河 hé and 哥 gē.
舌 (tongue) — 舌 is the tongue, as in 话, 活; 辞 is words and speech, and the same sound as 词 cí.
